abstract: The aim of this study was to glyco- and immunohistochemically analyze expression of distinct growth/adhesion-related markers of primary testicular carcinomas and their lung metastases in relation to the risk of developing lung metastases and survival of patients, and to correlate immunohistochemical staining profile and syntactic structure analysis in order to delineate new prognostic parameters for this tumor type. Clinical features of 50 patients with primary testicular carcinomas and their corresponding lung metastases were evaluated and compared to those of a control cohort of 25 cases. The set of eight probes including labeled galectins-1 and -3, specific non-cross-reactive antibodies against galectins-1, -3, and -8 as well as anti-Ki-67, anti-bcl-2, and anti-p53 was applied to formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tumor sections of both primary and metastatic lesions. Syntactic structure analysis computed staining intensities and structural features of the tumor cells. These parameters were set into relation separately and in combination to clinical data including tumor stages, smoking habits, applied cytostatic therapy, disease-free interval, and survival. The risk of testis cancer patients to develop lung metastases depends in descending order on the tumor cell type (non-seminoma versus seminoma), tumor cell heterogeneity (mixed versus monomorphous cell type), age of patients, and pT stage. The extent of differential expression of galectin-related features between primary and secondary lesions was pronounced. Prognostic correlations for distinct galectin-related features were delineated in combination with data from syntactic structure analysis, for example cluster radius of galectin-3-positive tumor cells and post-surgical and total survival. Lengths of disease-free interval and total survival of patients were also correlated to characteristics obtained by syntactic structure analysis and their combination with galectin data in the first place, then to smoking habits, percentage of proliferating cells in the primary and secondary tumors, and finally to expression of certain galectins and of p53. Patients with non-seminoma testicular cancer should be thoroughly controlled for lung metastases. Regarding marker selection, our study underscores that further investigation of the growth-regulatory network of galectins is clearly warranted.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、原発性精巣がんおよびその対応する肺転移の組織における増殖・接着関連マーカーの発現を、糖鎖・免疫組織化学的に解析することを目的とした。肺転移リスクおよび生存との関係を検討した。50例の原発性精巣がんとその肺転移を対象に臨床情報を評価し、25例の対照群と比較した。ガレクチン-1、-3、ガレクチン-1、-3、-8に対する特異的抗体、Ki-67、bcl-2、p53を含む8種類のプローブを、原発および転移病変のホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋切片に適用した。構造解析により染色強度と腫瘍細胞の構造的特徴を算出した。これらのパラメータを臨床データ(病期、喫煙歴、施行された細胞障害性療法、無病期間、生存期間)と個別および組み合わせて関連付けた。精巣がん患者が肺転移を生じる危険性は、腫瘍細胞の型(非セミノーマ対セミノーマ)、腫瘍細胞の異質性(混在型対単一型)、年齢、pT病期の順に依存した。ガレクチン関連特徴の原発病変と続発病変での発現差は顕著であった。ガレクチン-3陽性腫瘍細胞のクラスター半径などの特徴は、術後生存期間と全生存期間に関連した。無病期間と全生存期間は、まず構造解析とガレクチンデータの組み合わせ、次に喫煙歴、原発・続発腫瘍の増殖細胞率、特定のガレクチンおよびp53の発現と関連した。非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者は肺転移について徹底的な管理が必要である。ガレクチンの増殖制御ネットワークのさらなる検討が明らかに必要である。
